pages.title: Glossotherium
pages.text: The Glossotherium ($(o)Glossotherium robustum$()) is an extinct mylodontid ground sloth that lived in South America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It had a broad muzzle suited to cropping grasses and low plants, and powerful forelimbs that may have been used for digging.$(br2)Like other mylodontids, its skin was reinforced with small bony nodules called osteoderms, a form of natural armour.
